segments.speaker: SPEAKER_01
segments.text: So - the onboarding, it takes us 6 weeks, and half of that is the manual approval chain, that is the real pain.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: That is a heavy chain. What would it mean if the approvals were automatic?

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_01
segments.text: It would save maybe 25 percent of setup time, and our CFO would still need to sign the final order.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00
segments.text: Got it. I will send the one-pager on the approval automation.

segments.speaker: SPEAKER_01
segments.text: Good. The criteria will be rollout speed and the audit trail.
